title: 第0019章 炼化法器服用聚灵丹第0020章 三层圆满白羽彤
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间
content_zh:
;;
陆青禾不知道周通大费周章在小院的禁制上做了手脚。
他正端坐在黑土空间，他面前摆放着两件法器，一件白色小剑，中品法器灵风剑，是用一种灵竹锻造的法剑，上面刻画灵风禁制。
使用起来快如闪电，百米之内取人首级不成问题。
第二件是防御软甲，是用来自深海之处的灵龟玄龟甲炼制而成的中品防御法器，水火不侵，能够挡住炼气后期修士的攻击。
现在陆青禾要做的是炼化两件法器，这样才能完全发挥法器的威能，在对敌的时候能挥之如臂。
陆青禾拿起灵风剑，打上自己的精神烙印，开始慢慢用灵力进行炼化。
用了整整一个月的时间，陆青禾才将灵风剑和玄龟甲炼化完成。
陆青禾操纵灵风剑在空中飞舞，他已经能够驱动灵风剑进行攻击了。
陆青禾收回灵风剑，脸上露出自得的笑容。
中品法器对外门弟子来说都是可遇不可求的宝物，外门弟子能够使用的大多都是下品法器。
更高的上品法器是根本不可能出现在炼气中期修士身上的，哪怕是炼气后期修士都很难获得。
一件中品法器，价值180灵石到350灵石之间，上品法器价值翻数倍，最差的上品法器也需要八百灵石，好一点的都是过千灵石。
他现在手中一攻一守两件中品法器，中品防御法器能够挡住炼气中期修士的攻击，中品法器的灵风剑能够斩碎炼气中期的灵气罩。
陆青禾自信他现在的实力已经不弱于炼气中期的修士。
这就是法器的威能，每一个修仙者都希望自己能够拥有一件强大的法器伴身。
但是法器也不是万能的，也有着它的缺陷，一个是炼气三层，陆青禾并不能够御物飞行。
其次是炼气三层的灵力太过于薄弱了。
等到灵气耗尽，法器就失去了作用，到时候就成了待宰的羔羊。
陆青禾调整了两天，他拿出一瓶丹药，聚灵丹。

他打算试试聚灵丹的效果。
陆青禾从瓶中取出一颗乳白色的丹药，浓浓的丹香扑面而来。
相比起他之前吃过的醒灵丹药香重数倍不止。
醒灵丹和百草丹一样只是最低等的丹药，而聚灵丹则是真正的下品丹药。
陆青禾一口将聚灵丹吞了下去。
陆青禾运转功法开始炼化聚灵丹的灵力进行修炼。
两个时辰之后，陆青禾将一颗聚灵丹完全的炼化，修为虽然增加了不少，可是并没有预想的那么多。
陆青禾算了一下，聚灵丹的效果只是相当于吞食五十年份血参的五分之一。
要炼化五颗聚灵丹，也就是一瓶聚灵丹，才相当于五十年份血参的效果。
但是不能说聚灵丹没有没有用处，对陆青禾来说聚灵丹的用处要远远的超过血参的作用。
聚灵丹的药力相比起血参更加适合用来修炼。
他一天可以承受一颗聚灵丹的炼化，五天能够炼化一瓶聚灵丹。
相比起血参需要半个月的时间炼化要缩短三倍。
也就说他如果有源源不断的聚灵丹，他达到炼气四层的时间将会减少两倍。
还有就是价值，一株五十年份的血参价值二十五块灵石，但是一瓶聚灵丹只是十块灵石。
无论从哪个角度来说使用聚灵丹修炼更加的实惠划算，快捷。

Lu Qinghe didn't know that Zhou Tong had gone to great lengths to impose restrictions on the small courtyard.
He was sitting upright in the black earth space. There were two magic weapons in front of him, a small white sword and a medium-grade magic weapon, the Spirit Wind Sword. It was a magic sword forged from a kind of spiritual bamboo, with spiritual wind restrictions engraved on it.
It is as fast as lightning to use, and it is no problem to decapitate people within a hundred meters.
The second piece is the defensive soft armor, which is a medium-grade defensive weapon made from the tortoise armor from the deep sea. It is impervious to water and fire and can block the attacks of monks in the late stage of Qi refining.
What Lu Qinghe needs to do now is to refine two magic weapons so that they can fully unleash their power and be able to wield them like an arm when facing the enemy.
Lu Qinghe picked up the Spirit Wind Sword, stamped it with his own spirit, and began to slowly refine it with spiritual power.
It took Lu Qinghe a full month to refine the Spirit Wind Sword and Black Tortoise Armor.
Lu Qinghe controlled the Spirit Wind Sword to fly in the air. He could already drive the Spirit Wind Sword to attack.
Lu Qinghe took back the Spirit Wind Sword with a proud smile on his face.
Middle-grade magic weapons are rare treasures for outer disciples, and most of the ones that outer disciples can use are low-grade magic weapons.
It is impossible for higher-grade magic weapons to appear on monks in the middle stage of Qi refining, and it is difficult for even monks in the late stage of Qi refining to obtain them.
A medium-grade magic weapon is worth between 180 and 350 spirit stones, and a high-grade magic weapon is worth several times that. The worst high-grade magic weapon requires 800 spirit stones, and the better ones cost more than a thousand spirit stones.
He now has two middle-grade magical weapons in his hands, one for offense and one for defense. The middle-grade defensive magical weapon can block the attacks of monks in the middle stage of Qi refining. The middle-grade magical weapon, the Spirit Wind Sword, can shatter the spiritual energy shield in the middle stage of Qi refining.
Lu Qinghe is confident that his current strength is no weaker than that of a monk in the middle stage of Qi refining.
This is the power of a magical weapon. Every cultivator hopes to have a powerful magical weapon with him.
However, the magical weapon is not omnipotent, and it also has its flaws. One is that at the third level of Qi Refining, Lu Qinghe cannot control objects and fly.
Secondly, the spiritual power at the third level of Qi Refining is too weak.
When the spiritual energy is exhausted, the magic weapon loses its function and becomes a lamb to be slaughtered.
Lu Qinghe adjusted for two days, and then he took out a bottle of elixir, Spirit Gathering Pill.
He planned to try the effect of the Spirit Gathering Pill.
Lu Qinghe took out a milky white elixir from the bottle, and the strong fragrance of elixir hit his face.
Compared with the awakening pills he had taken before, the fragrance was several times stronger.
The Awakening Pill, like the Baicao Pill, is only the lowest elixir, while the Spirit Gathering Pill is a truly low-grade elixir.
Lu Qinghe swallowed the Spirit Gathering Pill in one gulp.
Lu Qinghe started to refine the spiritual power of the Spirit Gathering Pill by running his exercises.
Two hours later, Lu Qinghe completely refined a spirit-gathering pill. Although his cultivation level increased a lot, it was not as much as expected.
Lu Qinghe did some calculations and found that the effect of the Spirit Gathering Pill was only one-fifth of that of swallowing fifty-year-old blood ginseng.
It takes five spirit-gathering pills to be refined, which is one bottle of spirit-gathering pill, to be equivalent to the effect of fifty-year-old blood ginseng.
But it cannot be said that the Spirit-Gathering Pill is useless. For Lu Qinghe, the usefulness of the Spirit-Gathering Pill far exceeds the effect of blood ginseng.
The medicinal power of the Spirit Gathering Pill is more suitable for cultivation than the blood ginseng.
He can withstand the refining of one Spirit-Gathering Pill in one day, and can refine a bottle of Spirit-Gathering Pill in five days.
Compared with blood ginseng, which takes half a month to refine, it is three times shorter.
In other words, if he had a steady stream of Spirit Gathering Pills, the time it would take him to reach the fourth level of Qi Refining would be reduced by twice.
There is also the value. A fifty-year-old blood ginseng is worth twenty-five spiritual stones, but a bottle of spirit-gathering pill is only ten spiritual stones.
No matter from any perspective, using the Spirit Gathering Pill to practice is more cost-effective and faster.
